topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Well, I suppose the Lord in His great wisdom has decided that one more pair of hands be pulled from the fields, just when the wheat cries out for the harvest. I hear they’re moving him over to tend the new vineyard, as if we have the time for such luxury with the winter's frost nipping closer. Who will bind the sheaves now? And what of the debts piling higher than the church steeple? The Saints above must have their reasons, but they don’t fill my belly with bread or clear the ledger of the lord’s marks. I say this with no ill will, but mark my words, the harvest will not wait, and the soil won’t be forgiving to those who dabble in newfangled ideas instead of keeping the old ways true.
